The deep dives teach with real, bound mechanisms drawn from the actual kit (stencilLantern, alexnetCathedral, mistyHills, attentionMath, threadsOfLight, transformerLoom, typeSlugs). Examples: a 3 × 3 tin stencil sums light to a real number. A cathedral has true layer widths. A jug of light pours into cups at the real softmax shares (0.20 · 0.07 · 0.53 · 0.20). The unscaled jug freezes the gradient arrows. Position is clock faces with their sine strips behind. The causal curtain snaps forward threads to zero. None of it is boxes and arrows.

Every shot now leads with a one-sentence 'THIS SHOT:' idea, and each is specific and drawable in the silhouette language. Across 120 shots there is not one talking head. Even the founding and deaths shots carry a picture (a lamp going dark across the snow, a dedication opened by hands, two hand-lanterns on one nail).

The study apparatus is a genuine piece of information design. Belief candles whose dark sleeves are bars of years, the case board that is revealed as a lantern network, the X-ray column lighting one band per era and the Wall of Forecasts give a 32-minute history a visible clock and a running ledger of who believed what, and for how long. The finale cashes it in with one continuous pull-back.

Fairness is composed into the frames rather than only stated. Both shores are mirror-balanced at equal warmth. Founding rows are identical for OpenAI and Anthropic. Lab lamps are the same scale under 'the same light'. Gebru's departure has two equal cards. The study candles appear over the strait only as a reflection.
